description: DIMENSION is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by EWI. The energy market model optimises the future development of power plants, renewable energies and flexibility options for the provision of energy (especially electricity, heat and gaseous energy sources). In doing so, the model depicts the cost-minimising use and capacity expansions as well as the decommissioning of various technologies. Coverage: not restricted to one place on the factsheet. Methodical focus: energysystem model, investment model. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the factsheet. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.

outputs: DIMENSION calculates the total system costs (capital stock, generation, conversion and distribution), the short-term development of energy flows and prices, the capacities of the European electricity market, the generation mix and the CO2 emissions of the heat and power supply by sector, energy imports and power-to-X as well as many other important decision parameters.
